type A = { readonly a: number; readonly b: string };
type B = { [K in keyof A as "x"]: A[K] };
const b: B = { x: 1 };
b.x = 2;
type C = { a?: number; b?: string };
type D = { [K in keyof C as "x"]: C[K] };
const d: D = {};
console.log(d);
type E = { a?: number; b: string };
type F = { [K in keyof E as "x"]: E[K] };
const f: F = {};
type G = { readonly a: number; b: string };
type H = { [K in keyof G as "x"]: G[K] };
const h: H = { x: 1 };
h.x = 2;
